name: 🥣 Overnight Oats
what: Oats, milk and yogurt stirred together at night, ready in the fridge in the morning.
early: Night before: mix and fill the jars (they need 6 hours). Jars keep 4 days.
extras: berries, bananas, sliced almonds, honey, cinnamon, chia seeds

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
Stir 2 cups oats, 2 cups milk, 1½ cups yogurt, honey, cinnamon and a pinch of salt.
Spoon into 4 jars, berries on top. Lids on, into the fridge overnight.
Morning: stir, add banana and almonds, go.

key: A pinch of salt makes it taste like dessert.
done: Oats are soft and thick, not runny.
plan_b: Forgot last night? Microwave the same mix 2 minutes for hot oatmeal.
